title: Sensor Calibration Line Items in Wayfare Repair Schedule Estimates — Cleaning and Damage Fees
content:
**Rule.** The sensor calibration charge of a Wayfare repair schedule estimate on a Cleaning and Damage Fees damage report depends on the level held and the reported trip's ride option: an exterior repair on Wayfare Black or Wayfare Black SUV takes the full calibration charge; an exterior repair on Wayfare Comfort or Wayfare XL, or an interior repair on Wayfare Black or Wayfare Black SUV, takes the partial calibration charge; any other repair takes no calibration charge. The calibration charge is added to the estimate.

| Ride option on the trip record | Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) | Damage Fee (Interior Repair) |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Black or Wayfare Black SUV | $95.00 full calibration | $40.00 partial calibration |
| Wayfare Comfort or Wayfare XL | $40.00 partial calibration | none |
| Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Standard or Wayfare Green | none | none |

The ride option is read from the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares), and the level is the fee level the report holds.

**Reading the matrix.** An interior repair on a Wayfare XL trip takes no calibration charge, while an exterior repair on the same trip takes $40.00.
